noaa.helperText: No API key required. NOAA data is free and public (US only).

yr.helperText: No API key required. Provided by the Norwegian Meteorological Institute with global coverage. To test, use a Nordic lat/lon — e.g. Oslo (59.9139, 10.7522) — for the densest coverage.

smhi.helperText: No API key required. Provided by the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute. Nordic coverage only — to test, use a Nordic lat/lon (e.g. Stockholm: 59.3293, 18.0686). Returns no data outside the Nordic region.

metOffice.keyHint: Sign up at datahub.metoffice.gov.uk and subscribe to the Site-Specific API to get a key.
metOffice.placeholder: Paste your Met Office DataHub API key

envCanada.helperText: No API key required. Provided by Environment and Climate Change Canada — the authoritative forecast source inside Canada. Home Screens picks the nearest of ~844 city sites to your latitude/longitude; locations more than 200 km from any Canadian city are rejected. To test, try Toronto (43.6532, -79.3832) or Vancouver (49.2827, -123.1207).
